Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: You aren't given a verbal answer, but one that involves a hand gently latching onto your chin. It tugs you closer to Canuck Kweebec while it climbs upward, eventually cupping one of your cheeks.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Your eyes meet the amber galaxy that exists within his own. You never appreciated how alien Kweebec eyes are: the way that they better resemble globules of sparkling liquid than what you'd find in an animal.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: It doesn't take him long to close the last bit of distance between the two of you, at which point you can swear that your heart skips a beat. A tough branch comes to rest against your back in the same moment that you feel lips of bark seizing your own.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: (Someone else in your position would complain about how it feels more like kissing a rock than an actual being, but you don't have a point of reference if you've made it this far into the mod.)

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: It feels like a few splinters already managed to embed themselves into one of your lips, but whatever. You'll live. Only you and a sentient maple tree exist in this moment.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Speaking of, you catch a whiff of that syrupy sweetness in his breath, and part of you realizes that you've never considered what Kweebec saliva is made out of. Do they even salivate? Is this appropriate to think about right now?

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Well, if it *is* maple syrup, who cares where it comes from? That thing is freaking delicious.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Before you are able to take any action about your morbid curiosity, he breaks off your kiss. He does it so forcefully that you would've fallen back if not for the arm still wrapped around you.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Je suis désolé ! I was so joyous in the moment that--

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: You interrupt him by sliding a glove off his now-free hand, and grabbing onto the strong twigs that are revealed in the process. Wherever that thing ends up, you neither look nor care.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: It's a bit different like this. It doesn't change the fact that he's cold-blooded -- cold-sapped? -- but holding the bare bark makes you feel a genuine connection with this plant. Like you don't hail from two different biological kingdoms.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Like you're able to see yourself devoting a significant amount of time to whatever's blossoming between you two.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Whether from rain or your personal troubles, you feel that this tree will try his best to shelter you from it all. In fact, he seems to demonstrate that when he leans in again.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Is it too soon to call you mon amour ? I have not had much, erm ...

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He doesn't even give you an opportunity to answer before he sweeps you off your feet and tangles his branches in your hair.

Line.Text: Has it hit you yet that your beau is a tree? You do you, but... you know. That's not what they meant by 'hugging trees'.
